content.user_title: Prepare and Track Your Toolfound Product Launch
content.value_statement: Product launches require accurate listing details, suitable dates, and clear ownership verification. This skill guides Toolfound research, listing preparation, approved submission, and status tracking through MCP.
actual_capabilities: Guide remote Toolfound MCP configuration for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and VS Code.
Use Toolfound categories, product search, and alternatives to research listing language and competing options.
Consult the launch calendar, queue counts, and current free-slot availability to recommend launch timing.
Draft factual listing copy and submit only after approval of the exact listing fields.
Explain returned ownership verification methods and check launch status through Toolfound.
Retrieve listing badge snippets and require a maker request before insertion.
limitations: Requires a compatible remote MCP client and access to the external Toolfound service.
Directory results are not independent verification of product claims or competing products.
Cannot guarantee free slots, publication, or a specific launch date.
The owner must complete verification; the skill does not provide local scripts or an offline launch service.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Product Listing
use_cases.description: Turn maker-confirmed facts into a tagline and description, then review all fields before submitting a first Toolfound listing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Launch Date
use_cases.description: Compare directory categories and alternatives, inspect calendar availability, and recommend timing based on readiness and queue counts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Verification and Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Explain owner verification steps, check launch status, and retrieve a badge after the listing exists.

prompt_templates.title: Connect Toolfound
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure the Toolfound MCP endpoint in [client]. Explain the required configuration and ask before changing local settings.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Listing Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Toolfound listing for [product] using these confirmed facts: [facts]. Ask for missing details and do not submit anything.

prompt_templates.title: Research Launch Timing
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Toolfound categories and alternatives for [product]. Check the launch calendar and free-slot availability, then recommend dates based on [readiness constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate an Approved Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the Toolfound launch for [product]. Present every submission field and wait for my approval before submitting. Explain returned verification steps and check status.

output_examples.input: Draft a listing for a task manager serving freelance designers. Pricing is not decided. Do not submit.
output: Tagline: Task management for freelance designers.
Description: A task manager for freelance designers to organize their work.
Missing details: Product name, canonical HTTPS URL, owner email, pricing, and confirmed differentiators.

output_examples.input: Explain what happens after I approve my Toolfound listing.
output: Submit only the exact fields you approved.
Explain the verification options returned by Toolfound: site meta tag, DNS TXT record, or emailed magic link.
The owner completes verification; report success only when Toolfound confirms it.
Check launch status and retrieve badge snippets after a listing exists.
Insert a badge only when you request it.

best_practices: Use maker-confirmed facts and clearly separate Toolfound directory information from independently verified evidence.
Review the exact URL, owner email, name, tagline, description, and optional public handle before approving submission.
Keep verification tokens and magic links private, and confirm status through the service before reporting success.
anti_patterns: Submitting a listing before the maker confirms the exact destination, owner email, and copy.
Promising free slots, launch dates, verification, or publication without current service evidence.
Publishing verification secrets or inserting a badge without the maker's request.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a client supporting remote MCP and a connection to the Toolfound endpoint. Setup examples cover several clients.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: It provides configuration examples for Claude Code and Codex. Other Claude clients need compatible remote MCP support.

faq.question: Will it submit my product automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow requires your confirmation of the exact listing fields before calling the submission tool.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a free launch slot?
faq.answer: No. It checks current availability and the launch calendar rather than promising a free slot or specific date.

faq.question: Who completes ownership verification?
faq.answer: The owner completes a returned verification method. The skill explains the steps and reports verification only after Toolfound confirms it.

faq.question: Does it insert listing badges without asking?
faq.answer: No. It can retrieve badge snippets after a listing exists, but insertion requires the maker's request.
